definition: Kira Radinsky (Hebrew: קירה רדינסקי; born July 28, 1986) is a Ukrainian-born Israeli computer scientist, inventor and entrepreneur, specializing in predictive data mining.
details: and artificial intelligence, a high-tech manager, scientist, and a visiting professor at the Technion. She is a member of the Israel Securities Authority. Former Director of Data Science and Chief Scientist at eBay Israel.
story: Picture a librarian organizing a million slips of paper so that any one of them can be found in a heartbeat. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Garbage in, garbage out — and the reverse: clean, representative data makes the model quietly brilliant. That care with the raw material is Kira Radinsky.
